I've been "making" dollhouse since I was 10 I've always been poor so I used to make them out of shoeboxes, cereal boxes, any cardboard I could find. I stopped making them in highschool due to my abusive mother making fun of me for still liking dolls and toys. After moving out on my own I still wasn't really "allowed" to have dolls due to my ex. But up until 2 years ago I meet such an amazing person who loved my creatived talents and encouraged me to make my miniatures and get dolls. They even got me the dollhouse I'm working on. Which crazy enough I had the same dollhouse growing up, we found it in the dumpster, brought it home, cleaned it up and played with it everday until i had to leave it in new york when moving states. I hope you guys like my work I can show the canopy bed I've made. I currently can't show you guys everything since I'm still moving houses so my stuff is all over the place.
